title: Reorganize core source layout around lifecycle domains
description:
packages/core/src has useful subdirectories but also root-level lifecycle files that are becoming a miscellaneous domain layer.

Group campaign, session, character, rules, state, memory, model, and persistence concerns more explicitly once the higher-priority refactors are stable.
acceptance_criteria:
- campaign lifecycle files are grouped.
- session lifecycle files are grouped.
- character creation/state files are grouped.
- imports/exports are updated.
- Existing tests pass.
- Public API compatibility is preserved or intentionally migrated.
notes: PR #171 open (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/171), branch feat/core-layout-toolrequest-seam-eshyra-0jq16. Two commits: (1) transport-neutral ToolRequest seam in orchestrator (prep for native tool use eshyra-1q5; fenced parser is the only producer today, native-rejection guard reframed as policy gate); (2) grouped campaign/session/character lifecycle files into domain dirs. config.ts/validation.ts intentionally kept at root. Barrels re-export unchanged so CLI/consumers unaffected. typecheck/test(1264 pass)/check/verify:worktree all green. Leave in_progress; close on merge.
close_reason: Merged via PR #171 (squash 30c18e0). Seam-aware core layout reorg: transport-neutral ToolRequest abstraction + campaign/session/character lifecycle grouping.
